opening.text: I have a hoarse voice that started gradually three months ago. I feel like there's a lump in my throat, and I've dropped 10 pounds in the last 3 months. I've also been feeling more tired recently. I smoke cigarettes, and my father had lung cancer while my mother had thyroid disease.
